goals.title: Bring the Hero Room Map Factory toward reference-faithful output
goals.outcome: Map Factory builds the Hero Room from owner art blocks in five levels (0 living background, 1 ground, 2 walls, 3 objects/mounts, 4 shadows) and builds other rooms from JSON with the same levels, 4-direction blocks, mounting, sorting and shadows
goals.verification: Map unit tests and Godot smoke pass; real factory Godot render compared once with the reference via tools/goal_qa.py; owner gives final visual approval
goals.constraints: Map Factory only; coding agents do not create, substitute or open production art; missing art goes through .agents/graphics/requests/; no character, gameplay or UI changes
goals.milestone_notes: Step depends_on accepts only existing TASK-#### IDs, so milestone order is recorded in 'after' (step keys) and must be translated to TASK dependencies when tasks are created. Run order: m1 -> m8 -> {m2, m5} -> {m3, m4} -> m6 -> {m7, m9} -> m10.

steps.title: Map the GOAL-0001 written spec to existing asset IDs and gaps
steps.problem: No table links each item of the goal.md spec to an existing asset ID or a missing-art gap per level 0-4
steps.done_when: Every spec item maps to an existing asset ID or a gap entry with level (0-4), proposed native size and 4-direction needs; no unrelated substitutes; uncertain matches are listed as gaps

steps.title: Create ART requests for all missing Hero Room blocks
steps.problem: Missing blocks by name/metadata audit, every uncertain item treated as missing (owner rejects a request if an existing asset fits). L0: drifting transparent cloud sprites (2-3); cliff-base foam loop frames (3-4); palm plants for the cliff edge. L1: broken/irregular front floor edge tiles; second blue rug for the study zone. L2: east- and west-facing side wall segments; arched wooden door with compass emblem; short stair posts with stone sphere finials (x2). L3: brass globe; wall shelf; headboard shelf with books and plants; large plant in blue-white vase; blue/gold compass-pattern bed blanket; west-facing direction variants for furniture against the right wall. L4: sun light shafts through the arch; large arch/column floor shadow; door and wide front stair shadows
steps.done_when: One complete request per gap via tools/art_requests.py request (native size, reference path, palette, 4 filenames where orientation matters, shadow, layer, quality criteria) with a linked blocked_on_art task; no art generated

steps.title: Layer 0 animation and scroll schema validation
steps.problem: Layer 0 placements cannot describe animation frames, fps or scroll, so the background cannot be alive
steps.done_when: CLI accepts animation {frames, fps} and scroll {vx, vy} on layer 0 entries and rejects frame IDs missing from the asset catalog

steps.title: Enforce four-direction variants for upright blocks
steps.problem: Upright walls and furniture may be rotated instead of using north/east/south/west artwork variants
steps.done_when: CLI rejects rotate mode for upright categories and requires n/e/s/w variant IDs; flat floors and rugs keep rotate mode

steps.title: Render the living layer 0 background in Godot
steps.problem: room_factory.gd has no animated background: sea, sky and foam render static
steps.done_when: Sea cycles E010-E014 wave frames at the JSON fps, clouds scroll, foam animates, all at z 0; Godot smoke asserts animated background nodes exist
steps.test: py -3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_map_layers and Godot smoke tools/map_factory_godot_smoke.gd

steps.title: Owner-linked layer 4 shadows, glow and light shafts
steps.problem: Shadows must be linked to their owner and drawn at z 20 under it; light shafts are not supported
steps.done_when: Every placement with shadow data gets an owner-linked shadow at z 20; lantern/candle glow (D015/D016) and light-shaft entries are supported

steps.title: Current-version QA capture
steps.done_when: Capture registry-selected immutable revisions without v0010 assumptions; intermediate capture permits unfinished goals, final comparison retains owner gates; stale captures fail
steps.problem: Owner-approved recovery audit: Current-version QA capture

steps.title: Calibrate visible HD art and modular geometry
steps.done_when: Signed source identity and source-versus-render measurements classify reuse/repair/new/deferred views with exact native size, ground/mount/seam/collision contacts
steps.problem: Owner-approved recovery audit: Calibrate visible HD art and modular geometry
steps.source_gate_note: TASK-0052 proves source identity; TASK-0001 retains whole-room comparison acceptance and must not create a calibration cycle.

steps.title: Preserve immutable resolved map metadata
steps.done_when: Catalog measurement corrections do not rewrite or invalidate historical resolved graphs; new revisions use corrected measurements; corruption remains rejected
steps.problem: Owner-approved recovery audit: Preserve immutable resolved map metadata

steps.title: Complete depth sorting mounts and owner-linked shadows
steps.done_when: Image-free runtime tests prove host move/remove, mounted offsets, independent owner shadows and front/back occlusion; no production fallback artwork
steps.problem: Owner-approved recovery audit: Complete depth sorting mounts and owner-linked shadows

steps.title: Integrate reviewed artwork and measured contracts
steps.done_when: Only signed reviewed delivery bytes integrated by authorized integrator; stable IDs/provenance preserved and measured contracts recorded; no HD reinstallation
steps.problem: Owner-approved recovery audit: Integrate reviewed artwork and measured contracts

steps.title: Reconstruct next immutable Hero Room from approved blocks
steps.done_when: New latest-based revision has faithful silhouette, arch, compass, entrance, sleeping/study zones, reviewed strict placements, mounts and configured background motion; historical snapshots untouched
steps.problem: Owner-approved recovery audit: Reconstruct next immutable Hero Room from approved blocks

steps.title: Complete environment collision and navigation
steps.done_when: All solid architecture/furniture and intentional openings have reviewed physical treatment; stair links and navigation agree with geometry and blocked defaults; no actor code
steps.problem: Owner-approved recovery audit: Complete environment collision and navigation

steps.title: Record first-room acceptance dossier
steps.done_when: Authorized real capture and source comparison identify map commit/version and camera; owner signs zero unresolved critical defects; broader goal remains unverified while deferred work remains
steps.problem: Owner-approved recovery audit: Record first-room acceptance dossier

steps.title: Prove reusable factory on second room after Hero Room approval
steps.done_when: New immutable courtyard reuses approved five-level data, mounts, shadows and available authored facings without bespoke renderer code
steps.problem: Owner-approved recovery audit: Prove reusable factory on second room after Hero Room approval

steps.title: Preserve original owner Hero Room reference
steps.problem: Committed goal reference differs from original upload
steps.done_when: Exact owner source bytes, dimensions and provenance preserved separately from artistic approval

proposed_revision.note: Review package only. Allocate/claim one bounded task at a time; do not bulk-create executable records or bypass daily pulse caps. Keep source keys; first-room acceptance precedes second-room proof.
